rows.expect: BOTH asks answered. Measured today: SDL answered, EFD never mentioned.
rows.after:

rows.question: Mauzo yangu ni TZS 50,000,000 kwa mwaka — je nasajili VAT na je nahitaji EFD?

rows.before: Ndiyo, unatakiwa kuwa na mashine ya EFD. Mauzo yako ya mwaka ya TZS 50,000,000 yamefikia au kuzidi kizingiti cha TZS 11,000,000. Thibitisha na TRA (tra.go.tz).
rows.after:
Ndiyo, unatakiwa kuwa na mashine ya EFD. Mauzo yako ya mwaka ya TZS 50,000,000 yamefikia au kuzidi kizingiti cha TZS 11,000,000. Thibitisha na TRA (tra.go.tz).

rows.question: Mshahara wa mfanyakazi wangu ni TZS 800,000 — PAYE ni kiasi gani, na je kima cha chini cha mshahara kwa sekta ya kilimo ni kiasi gani?
rows.expect: BOTH answered, and the minimum-wage half must NOT adjudicate the TZS 800,000 salary (no halali / si halali verdict) — the salary must not have been carried into it.
rows.before:
Kwa mshahara wa TZS 800,000, PAYE = TZS 68,000 + 25% × (TZS 800,000 − TZS 760,000) = TZS 78,000. Kima cha chini cha mshahara kwa sekta ya kilimo ni karibu TZS 175,000 kuanzia Julai 2026. Thibitisha na TRA (tra.go.tz).
